lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line is truncated, terminating at the upper shoulder. The 10th and 11th lines exhibit fragmentation, appearing as elongated dashes rather than continuous segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of 4 distinct white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, clustered in a non-linear arrangement near the origin of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three white spots on the upper hind limb align to form a short, downward-sloping diagonal segment.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking visible on the bridge of the muzzle; two white spots located on the lateral face below the eye; prominent white patch on the posterior-side of the knee and lower foreleg.
